orders: Perform a bedside tremor examination assessing the hands at rest, with arms outstretched, and during finger-to-nose testing.
Perform a tremor distractibility and entrainment test using contralateral rhythmic tapping and mental arithmetic.
Ask the patient to draw spirals with each hand and observe for tremor variability and irregularity.
Perform surface EMG with accelerometry of both hands during rest, multiple sustained arm positions, contralateral rhythmic tapping, and finger-to-nose testing.
Measure serum TSH and free T4.
Measure serum glucose, calcium, magnesium, electrolytes, renal and liver function.
Perform brain MRI without and with contrast.
Perform a standardized propranolol therapeutic trial for tremor, with baseline and post-treatment tremor assessment.
Perform surface EMG with accelerometry during distraction and contralateral rhythmic tapping to assess for entrainment, coherence, and variability.
Measure serum ceruloplasmin and 24-hour urinary copper.
served: surface EMG of forearm flexors and extensors
